description: A copy of ALM's Beast's Chalkboard: two precision adders, each passing its input straight through and offering two copies with a whole number of volts added

params.text: Adds a whole number of volts to the first section's pair of Out jacks, -2V to +2V in one-volt steps, and nothing at the centre
Adds a whole number of volts to the second section's pair of Out jacks, -2V to +2V in one-volt steps, and nothing at the centre

inputs.text: The signal the first section passes and adds to; it is also what the second section reads when nothing is patched there
The signal the second section passes and adds to; with nothing patched it takes the first section's input

outputs.text: The first input passed through with nothing added to it
The second input passed through with nothing added to it
The first input with the first switch's offset added
The second input with the second switch's offset added

notes: both switches come up at the centre, adding nothing, so out of the box the Out jacks carry exactly what the Thru jacks carry.
nothing is clamped anywhere. The offset is added to whatever arrives, so a large input can be pushed past the range other modules expect.
the module is monophonic: every jack reads or writes one channel.

inputs.0:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.1:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the first input.
